label: Прочитанный
description: A 10-sentence card for прочитанный, the past passive participle of прочитать, with its short form прочитан.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative long form. Прочитанный comes from the perfective прочитать — the stem прочита- plus the suffix -нн- and an adjective ending. The long form agrees with masculine роман.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative long form. The long participle takes -ая to agree with книга. Прочитанная книга equals книга, которую прочитали — the book that someone read.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative long form. Прочитанное carries the neuter ending -ое to match письмо. The -нн- suffix marks completion — the letter that had been read.
Strategic focus: Plural accusative long form. The plural ending -ые lets прочитанные agree with книги as the read books that were returned to the library.
Strategic focus: Feminine short form. The short predicative form прочитана agrees only in feminine gender with книга, with быть in the present understood. The book is finished.
Strategic focus: Neuter short form with быть. The short form прочитано joins было to form a past passive: письмо было прочитано. It reports that the letter got read aloud.
Strategic focus: Plural short form. The plural short form прочитаны agrees with главы and predicates the result with быть understood. The chapters are all read.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental long form. After доволен the noun статьёй stands in the instrumental, and прочитанной takes the matching feminine instrumental ending to agree with it.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о прочитанном вчера рассказе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional long form. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so рассказе and прочитанном take prepositional endings and agree as the story that was read.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive long form. Прочитанной takes the feminine genitive ending to agree with книги, marking whose cover it is — the cover of the book that was read.
